title: Australian Beef Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful skillet meal, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This Australian-inspired dish features tender beef and savory vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Remove beef from skillet and set aside.
Add onion and bell pepper to skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Add potato and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add tomato and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Return beef to skillet and season with salt and pepper to taste.
